---
title: "Get energy cost from World Bank"
---


```{r}
library(countrycode)
library(jsonlite)

# /*===========================================*/
#'=  1. Download World Bank electricity price =
# /*===========================================*/

wb_indicator <- "IC.ELC.PRI.KH.DB1619"
wb_year <- 2019L

wb_url <- paste0(
  "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/",
  wb_indicator,
  "?date=", wb_year,
  "&source=1",
  "&format=json",
  "&per_page=500"
)

wb_raw <- fromJSON(
  wb_url,
  flatten = TRUE
)

stopifnot(
  length(wb_raw) >= 2L,
  !is.null(wb_raw[[2]])
)

wb_electricity_raw <- as.data.table(
  wb_raw[[2]]
)


# /*===========================================*/
#'=  2. Clean electricity-price data =
# /*===========================================*/

wb_electricity_2019 <- wb_electricity_raw[
  !is.na(value) &
    nzchar(countryiso3code),
  .(
    wb_id = country.id,
    iso3 = countryiso3code,
    wb_country_name = country.value,
    year = as.integer(date),
    electricity_price_2019uscents_kwh =
      as.numeric(value)
  )
]

wb_electricity_2019[, electricity_price_2019usd_kwh :=
  electricity_price_2019uscents_kwh / 100]


# /*===========================================*/
#'=  3. Remove subnational Doing Business rows =
# /*===========================================*/

subnational_cities <- c(
  "Beijing",
  "Shanghai",
  "Chittagong",
  "Dhaka",
  "Delhi",
  "Mumbai",
  "Jakarta",
  "Surabaya",
  "Kano",
  "Lagos",
  "Karachi",
  "Lahore",
  "Los Angeles",
  "New York",
  "Mexico City",
  "Monterrey",
  "Moscow",
  "St. Petersburg",
  "Osaka",
  "Tokyo",
  "Rio de Janeiro",
  "Sao Paulo"
)

wb_electricity_2019 <- wb_electricity_2019[
  !wb_country_name %chin% subnational_cities
]

#/*--------------------------------*/
#' ## Validate
#/*--------------------------------*/
stopifnot(
  wb_electricity_2019[
    !is.finite(electricity_price_2019usd_kwh) |
      electricity_price_2019usd_kwh <= 0,
    .N
  ] == 0L
)

stopifnot(
  wb_electricity_2019[
    ,
    .N,
    by = iso3
  ][N > 1L, .N] == 0L
)

wb_electricity_2019[
  ,
  .N,
  by = iso3
][N > 1L]


# /*===========================================*/
#'=  3. Convert urban-center country ID to ISO3 =
# /*===========================================*/
uc_2025 <- readRDS(here("Data/Processed/ghsl_urban_centres_2025.rds"))

uc_2025[, iso3 :=
  countrycode(
    country_id,
    origin = "un",
    destination = "iso3c"
  )]

# Special statistical codes
uc_2025[country_id == 158, iso3 := "TWN"]
uc_2025[country_id == 412, iso3 := "XKX"]

uc_2025[
  is.na(iso3),
  unique(.(
    country_id,
    country_name
  ))
]

wb_electricity_2019[
  iso3 %in% c("TWN", "XKX"),
  .(
    iso3,
    wb_country_name,
    electricity_price_2019uscents_kwh,
    electricity_price_2019usd_kwh
  )
]

# /*===========================================*/
#'=  4. Attach electricity price to urban centers =
# /*===========================================*/

uc_2025[
  wb_electricity_2019[, .(
    iso3,
    electricity_price_2019uscents_kwh,
    electricity_price_2019usd_kwh
  )],
  on = "iso3",
  `:=`(
    electricity_price_2019uscents_kwh =
      i.electricity_price_2019uscents_kwh,
    electricity_price_2019usd_kwh =
      i.electricity_price_2019usd_kwh
  )]


# Inspect missing countries
missing_electricity_price <- uc_2025[
  is.na(electricity_price_2019usd_kwh),
  .(
    n_urban_centers = .N,
    population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(
    country_id,
    country_name,
    iso3
  )
][order(-population)]

missing_electricity_price

# Overall coverage
uc_2025[, .(
  n_urban_centers = .N,
  n_with_price =
    sum(!is.na(electricity_price_2019usd_kwh)),
  n_without_price =
    sum(is.na(electricity_price_2019usd_kwh)),
  share_with_price =
    mean(!is.na(electricity_price_2019usd_kwh))
)]

# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Save urban centers with electricity price =
# /*===========================================*/
saveRDS(
  wb_electricity_2019,
  here("Data/Processed/world_bank_electricity_price_2019.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  uc_2025,
  here("Data/Processed/uc_2025_with_electricity_price.rds")
)
```


```{r}
# rds to csv
wb_electricity_2019 <- readRDS(here("Data/Processed/world_bank_electricity_price_2019.rds"))

uc_2025 <- readRDS(here("Data/Processed/uc_2025_with_electricity_price.rds"))


write.csv(
  wb_electricity_2019,
  here("Data/Processed/world_bank_electricity_price_2019.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  uc_2025,
  here("Data/Processed/uc_2025_with_electricity_price.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
